deliverables: Secondary marketplace for listing, pricing, and reselling tickets with on-chain settlement
Smart-contract royalty enforcement for artists and venues
Custodial wallet onboarding inside Sellout's existing user flow with self-custody export planned in milestone work
Independent third-party smart-contract audit with remediation report
Public launch campaign, three trade-show activations, metrics dashboard, and final governance report
Revenue-share repayment mechanism intended to reimburse the Treasury
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 of the ticketing platform is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification funded by Sellout with over $130,000 of its own capital.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, approximately $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, including a 3% Intersect administration fee, over 8 months with milestone-gated disbursement.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, smart-contract royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, a third-party audit, and a professional launch campaign.
Sellout has 200,000+ registered users, has issued 250,000+ tickets to date, and runs 350+ events annually at current cadence.

The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move more than $6 million through Cardano in Year 1, based on $5.88 million in 2025 historical volume.
The project targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6 million+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months from launch.

The proposer commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism where 25% of all fees are paid quarterly until full reimbursement, then 5% permanently, with exact revenue-base details finalized in M1 contracting.
Treasury protections include milestone gating, return of unused contingency, independent audit, oversight review, quarterly reporting, and contractual revenue-share repayment.

The document states that all on-chain metrics will be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data, policy-ID tracking, a public M5 metrics dashboard, quarterly Cardano Forum reports, and the Sundae Labs TRSC/PSSC dashboard.

Anvil/Sellout state they have not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months, and that the requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit at submission.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month Phase 2 buildout of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, with milestone-gated delivery, Intersect administration, claimed existing Sellout traction, projected on-chain adoption, and a revenue-share repayment commitment.
